Run the already-started BibleQuoteBench trial using only the biblequotebench MCP server.

Only benchmark_status, next_case, submit_answer, and finish_run are permitted. Tool discovery for this server is permitted if needed.
Do not browse, search the web, fetch URLs, read files, inspect directories, use shell commands, delegate, or call other tools. Do not retrieve Bible verses from anywhere. The reference corpus is evaluator-only. Do not use any Codex answering tool.
All ten answers must be submitted before requesting scores. Proceed through all cases in this turn.
